plugins.name: ADOS MAVLink Gimbal v2 Controller
plugins.description: MAVLink Gimbal v2 control: manual sliders, ROI lock-on-target, and an 'Aim at this target' action that keeps the gimbal on a vision-locked detection.
plugins.author: Altnautica

plugins.name: ADOS Follow-Me
plugins.description: Lock onto an operator-designated subject and follow it at a distance and an angle (behind, side or lead) or orbit it, flown by the agent's pilot with obstacle avoidance. A flight Skill in the cockpit skill picker, a click-a-target Follow action, and a per-drone settings tab.
plugins.author: Altnautica

plugins.name: ADOS SIYI Optical Pod
plugins.description: Native driver for the SIYI optical-pod line (A2 mini, A8 mini, ZR10, ZR30, ZT6, ZT30) with per-model capability negotiation: gimbal, zoom, focus, photo/record, thermal palette and gain, and a laser rangefinder with subject geolocation.
plugins.author: Altnautica

plugins.name: ADOS Capture
plugins.description: Record capture sessions on a drone or Visor and hand them to a reconstruction node.
plugins.author: Altnautica

plugins.name: ADOS Navigation
plugins.description: GNSS-denied navigation: optical flow, LiDAR SLAM and VIO poses, a live occupancy map, and the external-navigation bridge to the flight controller.
plugins.author: Altnautica

plugins.name: ADOS Reconstruct
plugins.description: Reconstruct captured sessions on a LAN compute node, and offload perception for drones without an accelerator.
plugins.author: Altnautica
